description: #2016 — rows written before gh.pr.merge dropped `phase`/`slice_id` (two on the 4140 DB) still carry them in `subject`. `ForgeMergeSubject` ignores the retired keys, so replay still reads the PR number; re-serialization emits only `pr_number`. Adding `deny_unknown_fields` to the subject makes step 1 fail and this test goes red.
